species: C57BL/6J mice, Pmel mice with gp100-reactive TCR: B6.Cg-Thy1a/Cy Tg(TcraTcrb)8Rest/J, OT-II mice with MHC II-restricted OVA-specific TCR: B6.Cg-Tg(TcraTcrb)425Cbn/J, Sirt2−/− mice: B6.129-Sirt2tm1.1Fwa/J and NSG mice: NOD.Cg-Prkdcscid Il2rgtm1Wjl/SzJ were purchased from The Jackson Laboratory.
tissue: Unstimulated CD3+ TN cells and CD4+ OT-II TN cells were directly washed with PBS and lysed in the IP lysis buffer following their isolation from spleens.
cell_type: For the identification of Sirt2 interacting targets, CD3+ T cells were cultured on anti-CD3 coated-plates for 24 hr, washed with PBS and lysed in the IP lysis buffer.
disease_state: For identification of acetylated proteins, WT and Sirt2−/− CD3+ purified T cells were cultured on anti-CD3 coated-plates for 72 hr
sample_source: C57BL/6J mice, Pmel mice with gp100-reactive TCR: B6.Cg-Thy1a/Cy Tg(TcraTcrb)8Rest/J, OT-II mice with MHC II-restricted OVA-specific TCR: B6.Cg-Tg(TcraTcrb)425Cbn/J, Sirt2−/− mice: B6.129-Sirt2tm1.1Fwa/J and NSG mice: NOD.Cg-Prkdcscid Il2rgtm1Wjl/SzJ were purchased from The Jackson Laboratory.
age: Mice were used at 7–8 weeks of age with age- and sex-matched controls.
